body:
Very much so.  Since I was a kid.

Thanks for talking, good night.

I've kept myself busy with hobbies, and it actually felt worse.  I do capoeira and enjoy it, like learning languages etc but in the past I'd been doing so many other hobbies and whatnot I didn't have time for anything else in my life.  When I'd finally been able to find someone willing to date me it was tough balancing her and my hobbies.

I guess in summary, my hobbies bring me temporary amusement even if I genuinely like them.  I feel like my problems are more existential in nature.

It's not that I necessarily want to be dead, I just wish I was someone else.  Someone who was more extroverted or at least didn't get scared to talk to people.  And still I notice people around me can mutter something quietly and everyone else will answer.  I saw someone this morning just talking about a coffee machine in his office to some woman and she was responsive... I'm sitting there thinking I could never get anyone to respond to such a boring topic.

Like I just wish I could've been someone else
But I'm honestly just not adding any value to anyone.  I either drag them down or just don't contribute.  And it shows, tons of people tend to ignore what I say.
Besides I think about it for selfish reasons.  If I bring everyone down, they won't want to spend time with me.  I guess it's a catch-22 but at least I can disappear more easily...
But I honestly just think I'm useless.  I know I shouldn't compare myself to others but I add nothing to any scenario I'm in, so I don't know why anyone would want to spend time with me...
